{{Dialogue|Lekauf|The 327th Star Corps terminated the two Jedi after they were discovered attempting to poison the planet's water table.''"<br />[&hellip;]<br />'''Vader''': "''Are any mission officers still in service?|Lekauf|Two are on active duty at Yutusk&hellip;Commander Bly and Lt. Galle.|attr=[[Erv Lekauf]] and Darth Vader|src=<ref name="EG" />}}
'''Galle''', designated '''CT-6734''', was a [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|clone trooper lieutenant]] in [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Bly/Legends|Bly's]] [[327th Star Corps/Legends|327th Star Corps]] who fought in the [[Battle of Felucia (Outer Rim Sieges)/Legends|Battle of Felucia]]. Alongside [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Drake Lo'gaan/Legends|Drake Lo'gaan]], [[Ekria/Legends|Ekria]], and [[Zonder/Legends|Zonder]], he participated in a raid on a [[Water/Legends|water]] treatment plant near the city of [[Jiaozi/Legends|Jiaozi]] to stop the spread of a deadly toxin throughout [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia's]] water supply. After accomplishing this, Galle ordered the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] per the Republic directive [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], and he later filed the report on her execution.

During the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Galle was paired with Bly on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yutusk]]. When [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] called them into service, Galle and Bly aided Vader and [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Antinnis Tremayne]] in their search for Lo'gaan and Ekria, now Jedi fugitives, on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Piloting a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport]], Galle aided in Tremayne's pursuit of the Padawans in a chase through the airways of Coruscant.

==Biography==
===Early life and career===
[[Cloning/Legends|Cloned]] from [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]],<ref name="DB" /> [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] CT-6734 earned the name Galle. A [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], Galle was assigned to [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Bly/Legends|Bly's]] [[327th Star Corps/Legends|327th Star Corps]] and served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="EG" />

[[File:Bly-Galle-Barr-Inc.png|thumb|left|200px|Galle, alongside Bly, [[Barr]] and [[Inc]], utilizing [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]] to ambush [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]]]
Early in the war, the 327th attempted to reap information from the [[Memory bank/Legends|memory banks]] of a [[Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Aayla Secura's ambush)|Confederate tactical droid]] by setting up a trap in a rocky canyon. They were able to fabricate an information bunker, which attracted the attention of the droid. In turn, the [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|droid]] ordered his [[Troop/Legends|troops]] to attack the bunker, prompting Galle and the men of the 327th to attack them from the rear. They were able to effectively dispatch the droid's troops, while [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] beheaded the tactical droid. Since the droid had not gone into [[cyberostasis]], they would be able to plunder its memory banks for intel.<ref name="head">''[[The Clone Wars: Headgames]]''</ref>

===Service on Felucia===
{{Quote|What are you waiting for?!? Fire!''"<br />"''Yes, General.|Barriss Offee and Galle, before her execution by him|<ref name="ROF" />}}
At the close of the war, Galle was [[Battle of Felucia (Outer Rim Sieges)/Legends|dispatched]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], where the 327th and their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] leaders hunted [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]], presidente of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]]. When the 327th closed on Mai's compound outside the city of [[Kway Teow/Legends|Kway Teow]], believing her to be within it, they learned that she was not and it had been a trap. Their incursion triggered the release of a toxin into the planet's [[Water/Legends|water]] supply. The 327th and Jedi split into three groups, each intending to capture a water distribution center and block the spread of the toxin. Because their goal was to save lives, all sought to minimize enemy casualties. Galle and his squad joined the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Ekria/Legends|Ekria]], [[Drake Lo'gaan/Legends|Drake Lo'gaan]], and [[Zonder/Legends|Zonder]] in traveling to the center at [[Jiaozi/Legends|Jiaozi]], while [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] took a squad to [[Har Gau/Legends|Har Gau]] and [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and Bly went to [[Niango/Legends|Niango]].<ref name="ROF" />

[[File:Galle.jpg|thumb|200px|Galle on Felucia.]]
When Galle's group arrived at their site, they saw that the defenders consisted mostly of [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]], rather than [[Droid/Legends|droids]], and realized they could not simply blast their way into the center. Lo'gaan enlisted Galle's help for his plan; first, Zonder bellowed loudly, informing the defenders that there were attackers nearby, and the defenders charged. Galle and the Padawans attacked, striking down the droids. The Padawans then detached from Galle's squad, moving into position near the center. Lo'gaan [[Comlink/Legends|commed]] Galle and ordered him to activate the next phase of the plan, and Galle called for a retreat. The defenders pursued, leaving the way wide open for the Padawans to infiltrate the plant and stop the toxins.<ref name="ROF" />

As Galle fell back, Bly received an encrypted message from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], ordering him to execute [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], a contingency order that demanded the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of all Jedi. Galle and his squad rendezvoused with Offee, who was fighting off a number of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. Galle came to a halt, and Offee ordered him to fire. The lieutenant complied;<ref name="ROF" /> he ordered an AT-TE to open fire on Offee, killing her.<ref name="ROF" /><ref name="Felucia">{{DB|location|felucia|Felucia}}</ref>

===Under the Empire===
{{Quote|5052! 6734! Transmission from Coruscant. It's Priority Signal Bravo. Send me a souvenir from the Kessel spice mines.|A clone trooper, to Bly and Galle|<ref name="EG" />}}
Shortly after the execution of Order 66, the Republic was transformed into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Galle filed a report on Offee's death that later saw the attention of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. He and Bly, who had killed Secura, were publicly portrayed as having killed the Jedi to stop them from poisoning the Felucian water supply.<ref name="O66">{{InsiderCite|87|Order 66: Destroy All Jedi}}</ref> Galle and Bly were assigned to the world of [[Yutusk]], where anti-Imperial rallies were taking place.<ref name="EG" />

Ekria and Lo'gaan, however, eventually attracted the attention of the Empire. Over six months after the Empire was declared,<ref name="Prey">''[[Evasive Action: Prey]]''</ref> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Antinnis Tremayne]] found themselves in pursuit of the two Jedi. Tremayne had failed Vader in earlier attempts to take them, and so Vader, seeking help for Tremayne, looked for clone officers who had had experience with the Jedi on Felucia; he found Galle and Bly. Vader contacted them on Yutusk and offered them the chance to finish the job of eliminating their Jedi commanders, and the clones accepted.<ref name="EG" />

[[File:BlyIsardPasiqTremayne.jpg|thumb|left|190px|Galle in a meeting with Antinnis Tremayne, Lanu Pasiq, and Armand Isard.]]

Galle and Bly were transferred to Coruscant, where they met with Tremayne, fellow Inquisitor [[Lanu Pasiq]], and [[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand Isard]], head of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]]. Bly briefed the group on his experience with Ekria, in particular her aptitude at [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]], which he had seen demonstrated during the Felucia mission. Isard proposed that they attach markers to data that she would be likely to access and use them to trace her location. They were successful, tracking her to the apartment where the Jedi were hiding, and Tremayne, Pasiq, and a number of clone troopers set off in a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport]], with Galle and Bly piloting. As they approached, the apartment exploded, the result of a bomb set by the two Jedi to cover their tracks. They spotted the [[Airspeeder/Legends|speeder]] that Ekria and Lo'gaan were fleeing in, however, and set off after it. Bly called in reinforcements in [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|V-wing starfighters]], who were able to damage the speeder. Ekria bailed from the vehicle, but Tremayne ordered Galle to stay on Lo'gaan.<ref name="EG" />

Lo'gaan at last reached his destination, a landing pad where Darth Vader waited. Lo'gaan attempted to kill the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]], but Vader and his [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] guards were able to subdue him. When Tremayne, Bly, and Galle arrived, the situation had been dealt with, and Vader informed Tremayne that he was taking Lo'gaan into his custody.<ref name="EG" />

==Personality and traits==
Galle was loyal to the Republic and Empire.<ref name="EG" /><ref name="ROF" /> Willing to serve under and help Padawans, he was nonetheless capable of turning on and killing his Jedi superiors when ordered to. Though a soldier, he was not adverse to tactically retreating when necessary.<ref name="ROF" /> Galle was both capable in fighting as an infantry soldier and piloting air vehicles like the LAAT.<ref name="EG" /><ref name="ROF" />

==Equipment==
Galle wore [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]], decorated in the yellow piping common among members of the 327th Star Corps. His helmet was suited for hazardous environments and provided its own oxygen supply. He armed himself with a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]].<ref name="CVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Galle was created in [[Paul Ens]]' and [[Tom Hodges]]' [[Star Wars comic books|webstrip]] ''[[Reversal of Fortune]]''; the author and artist later used him again in ''[[Evasive Action: End Game]]'', a sequel strip to ''Reversal of Fortune'', which gave him the number "6734"; ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' later established his full designation as CT-6734. ''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]'' gave Galle his first realistic&mdash;as opposed to drawn&mdash;image, assigning the name to a reused picture of Bly from ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''.
